svg.title: Lindiwe AI signal pipeline from game telemetry to credit products
svg.desc: Four-stage pipeline: game actions emit events, telemetry processor extracts signals, Lindiwe context updates three model branches, which produce actionable credit and governance outputs.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What game actions are captured in a telemetry payload — explain the event structure')
sendPrompt('How is a GameEvent hashed and signed — show the event structure')
sendPrompt('What does the append-only game event log look like at the schema level?')
sendPrompt('What does the telemetry processor in src/lib/games/telemetry.ts actually compute?')
g.text: Extracts 7 behavioural signals → builds fingerprint → strips raw events

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is Risk Appetite Index scored from game decisions — what counts as high vs low risk?')
sendPrompt('How is Cooperative Quotient measured across The Commons and Ubuntu Monopoly?')
sendPrompt('How does the Pool Simulator measure stress response — what triggers the signal?')
sendPrompt('What in-game behaviours generate the Leadership Index signal?')
sendPrompt('What overextension patterns does Market Maker detect and how are thresholds set?')
sendPrompt('How is Financial Knowledge Score calculated across all five games?')
sendPrompt('What is the exact Lindiwe credit risk model update — define the CreditSignal output schema')
sendPrompt('How does Lindiwe use the Leadership Index to recommend governance roles?')
sendPrompt('How does the education pathway router use Knowledge Score to assign learning content?')
sendPrompt('What does an actionable CreditProduct look like — define the output schema in TypeScript')
sendPrompt('What triggers an early warning flag from Lindiwe before default appears in the ledger?')
sendPrompt('How is early-warning counselling triggered before a member shows distress in their contribution record?')
sendPrompt('How does the SovereigntyProxy allow game history erasure without corrupting the ledger?')
g.text: Consent gate → erasure → derived signals only stored (not raw events)
